episodes.synopsis: Ming Xian, in disguise, loses the Qingyun Martial Arts Tournament and suspects someone poisoned her. To find the antidote, she assumes a new identity.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.synopsis: Under her new alias, Ming Yi tries to divert attention away from her investigation of Wugui Sea — but Ji Bozai is suspicious of her.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: After Ji Bozai catches Ming Yi eavesdropping, he puts her to the test. He also learns the truth about his master's death and Houzhao's true intentions.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.synopsis: Ming Yi learns more about the whereabouts of the antidote — but to retrieve it, she must get closer to Ji Bozai and concocts a plan to gain his trust.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.synopsis: Ming Yi and Ji Bozai grow closer after she injures herself while helping him steal his master's portrait. Yan Xiao stops Tianji from visiting her father.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.synopsis: Yan Xiao rescues Tianji, revealing his true feelings. As Ming Yi's real identity threatens to surface, Ji Bozai's plan begins to take shape.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.synopsis: Ming Yi realizes Ji Bozai feels guilty for using her. As the court presses for the antidote, she discovers that someone knows her true name.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.synopsis: Situ Ling agrees to protect Ming Yi's identity. When she takes drastic measures to defend Wugui Sea, others misunderstand her intentions.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.synopsis: Ji Bozai and Ming Yi must work together to save Zhang Tai from Xun Ming, who has captured him in hopes of resurrecting his beloved late wife.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.synopsis: While stuck in Xun Ming's illusion maze, Ji Bozai and Ming Yi make a shocking discovery about his marriage to Xinliu that puts Ji Bozai in danger.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.synopsis: Ji Bozai and Ming Yi work to expose the truth about Xun Ming's marriage to Xinliu, while also navigating their true feelings for each other.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.synopsis: Situ Ling stirs drama amid Ji Bozai and Ming Yi's relationship, which is only growing stronger. Ming Yi finds a disturbing letter from Xin Liu.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.synopsis: In the Sunken Abyss, Twenty-Seven's mission goes wrong. Meanwhile, Mu Qibai reveals Ming Yi's identity and exposes a secret Ji Bozai holds.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.synopsis: Heavenly punishment strikes Ji Bozai, and Ming Yi risks everything to save him. Later, they reach an agreement to work together and expose Mu Qibai.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.synopsis: Mu Qibai captures commoners for his own evil plan. Twenty-Seven discovers the location of the Soul-Eating Tree. Ji Bozai uncovers a shocking murder.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.synopsis: When Ji Bozai resolves to avenge the Sunken Abyss, Ming Yi offers aid by dealing with Mu Qibai. Situ Ling's obscured heritage comes to light.

episodes.title: Episode 17
episodes.synopsis: Ji Bozai struggles with his own inner demons while trying to absorb the demon beast. Tian Ji teams up with Ming Yi after an unexpected danger arises.

episodes.title: Episode 18
episodes.synopsis: When Ji Bozai regains clarity, Ming Yi stays by his side. Mu Qibai's men seek to confront Ji Bozai, and Mu Qibai uses Ming Yi as a bargaining chip.

episodes.title: Episode 19
episodes.synopsis: Sun Liao sets a trap for Ming Yi and interrogates her under a powerful spell. Ji Bozai rescues her and hears a startling confession.

episodes.title: Episode 20
episodes.synopsis: After regaining her senses, Ming Yi avoids Ji Bozai. Twenty-Seven urges her to focus on the antidote, while Ji Bozai makes a declaration of his own.

episodes.title: Episode 21
episodes.synopsis: Summoning a demon beast, Mu Qibai attacks during a festival, stoking chaos at Ji Xing Abyss. Fighting back, Ming Yi wields a demon-sealing instrument.

episodes.title: Episode 22
episodes.synopsis: Ji Bozai and Ming Yi confront the demon, but the encounter leaves them shaken. Ji Bozai opens up to Ming Yi, yet she remains torn about her desires.

episodes.title: Episode 23
episodes.synopsis: An unexpected clash between Ji Bozai and Ming Yi changes the course of their relationship. Tian Ji uncovers the secret of the Fortune Flower.

episodes.title: Episode 24
episodes.synopsis: Situ Ling agrees to help Ming Yi find a different source for the Golden Millet Dream. Ming Yi travels into the Sunken Abyss with She Tianlin to find it.

episodes.title: Episode 25
episodes.synopsis: Situ Ling sets off a chain of events that puts the Sunken Abyss region in peril. When Ji Bozai learns that Ming Yi is in danger, he rushes to her rescue.

episodes.title: Episode 26
episodes.synopsis: Ji Bozai forces Ming Yi to make a confession to him. But danger soon arises when they encounter a Candle Dragon and a troubling incident of poisoning.

episodes.title: Episode 27
episodes.synopsis: Situ Ling uses a fox clan technique to heal Ming Yi but it comes with consequences. Ji Bozai pledges support to Tianji and later uncovers a secret.

episodes.title: Episode 28
episodes.synopsis: Still suffering from the effects of the Sorrow Toxin, Ji Bozai helps Ming Yi recover and together they partially restore the Mirror of Affairs.

episodes.title: Episode 29
episodes.synopsis: Situ Ling and Ming Xin strike a deal. Bu Xiu enters a competition to win the materials needed to revive Twenty-Seven. Ji Bozai and Ming Yi reconcile.

episodes.title: Episode 30
episodes.synopsis: Lost pieces of Ming Yi's history come to light and she enlists Jing Shu to help uncover the mystery of what happened a generation ago.

episodes.title: Episode 31
episodes.synopsis: Ming Yi and Ji Bozai learn the truth about the crown prince, but the fallout from this revelation comes with dire consequences for both.

episodes.title: Episode 32
episodes.synopsis: Ji Bozai makes a sacrifice and accepts his path to protect everyone else. Meanwhile, turmoil hits the Qing Yun Tournament audition.

episodes.title: Episode 33
episodes.synopsis: Ming Yi enters the tournament battles with her true identity exposed. At Zhang Tai's wedding, romance and tragedy unfold around Ji Bozai.

episodes.title: Episode 34
episodes.synopsis: Ming Yi makes a difficult choice to save Ji Bozai as a revolt against the Divine Lord of Zhu Shui begins, with a vengeful Situ Ling at the helm.

episodes.title: Episode 35
episodes.synopsis: Ming Yi and Ji Bozai decide to face the Heaven-Devouring Array together, while a desperate Situ Ling takes drastic measures to fight against them.

episodes.title: Episode 36
episodes.synopsis: As the Heaven-Devouring Array closes in, Ji Bozai and Ming Yi uncover the past with Lin Ziyao's help and together decide what their future will hold.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.synopsis: Wary of a power struggle, the Tiansheng emperor decides to send away Ning Yi, who spends his days weaving silk and rueing a traumatic event in his past.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.synopsis: Feng Zhiwei intervenes when Madam Yuhua bullies courtesan Zhu Yin. An assassination stirs the court. The other princes see Ning Yi as a growing threat.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: Ning Yi keeps up his disguise when Zhiwei arrives at the Prince of Chu's residence. Zhiwei is forced by her mother to swear she'll never marry Ning Yi.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.synopsis: The emperor confronts his sons about the rumors regarding the Dacheng prince. Yuhua suspects a link between Zhiwei and the fallen Dacheng Empire.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.synopsis: Following Ning Chuan's campaign against the Bloody Pagoda, the suspicious emperor appoints Ning Yi to investigate -- but Chief Gu's cooperation is key.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.synopsis: Chief Gu uncovers the conspiracy behind the Bloody Pagoda. Madam Yuhua goes to town and hears a story about Gu Heng and the infant Dacheng prince.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.synopsis: Ning Yi finds the document inscribed with information about Zhiwei's and Feng Hao's identities. Qiu Shangqi sends out a search party to catch Zhiwei.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.synopsis: After making a fateful pact, Chief Gu and Ning Yi involve Qiu Shangqi and Qiu Mingying in a scheme to ensnare Ning Chuan.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.synopsis: Zhu Yin helps Ning Yi get to the bottom of the killings linked to the Bloody Pagoda. Headmaster Xin suggests a ploy for Ning Chuan to test Ning Yan.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.synopsis: Ning Chuan reveals to Headmaster Xin his plans to overpower Duke Chang. Disguised as a man, Zhiwei begins work at the House of Lanxiang.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.synopsis: Ning Yan falls for Headmaster Xin's sorcery trick, confirming Ning Chuan's suspicions -- and Headmaster Xin increasingly gains Ning Chuan's trust.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.synopsis: Zhu Yin and Zhiwei suspect a plot by Ning Chuan to poison Ning Yi, but the emperor also falls ill. Duke Chang struggles to regain Ning Chuan's trust.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.synopsis: A mysterious new bodyguard stalks Zhiwei. Ning Yi sends Zhiwei to the East Palace to swap an artifact, resulting in grave consequences for Ning Yan.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.synopsis: Ning Yi confronts Ning Yan about his role in Ning Qiao's downfall. Ning Sheng suspects Ning Yi is involved in the scandal surrounding the wooden figure.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.synopsis: Headmaster Xin brings the sorcerer to Ning Yan, but an imposter hides behind the mask. The guilt-ridden emperor scrutinizes Ning Chuan's story.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.synopsis: Princess Shao Ning complains to Ning Chuan about her encounters at Qingming Academy. Ning Yi struggles to solve the mystery behind his illness.

episodes.title: Episode 17
episodes.synopsis: Ning Chuan sees the ring on Zhao Yuan and thinks it's a trap. Ning Yi orders his men to find Zhiwei, but Duke Chang is a step ahead.

episodes.title: Episode 18
episodes.synopsis: Ning Chuan plans a staged Bloody Pagoda assassination, but a counterscheme is in motion. Zhiwei appears at the imperial ceremony to select top scholars.

episodes.title: Episode 19
episodes.synopsis: At court, Chief Gu reveals Ning Chuan's Bloody Pagoda connections. Disillusioned with Ning Yi, Zhiwei ingratiates herself with the emperor.

episodes.title: Episode 20
episodes.synopsis: The emperor gets to the bottom of Ning Qiao's case. Shao Ning unknowingly helps Zhiwei identify the culprit behind an attempt to poison Ning Yi.

episodes.title: Episode 21
episodes.synopsis: Ning Yi warns Zhiwei about the Chang clan and confronts the emperor over his mother's death. Duke Chang and Ning Sheng try to conspire with Ning Chuan.

episodes.title: Episode 22
episodes.synopsis: Ning Yi anticipates Duke Chang and Ning Chuan's next move. Zhiwei struggles to convince Ning Yi to spare Ning Chuan's life.

episodes.title: Episode 23
episodes.synopsis: The courtiers pass verdict on Duke Chang's fate, but Ning Yi takes matters into his own hands. Shao Ning asks Qiu Shangqi about Zhiwei's past.

episodes.title: Episode 24
episodes.synopsis: With Ning Yi's help, Zhiwei forces Qiu Shangqi to retract his ultimatum and cave into her demands. Shao Ning is determined to avenge Ning Chuan.

episodes.title: Episode 25
episodes.synopsis: Ning Qi's return worries his mother, Lady Wang. Zhiwei comes up with a solution when Ning Qi expresses concerns about the horse market to the emperor.

episodes.title: Episode 26
episodes.synopsis: Suspecting intrigue, Ning Yi secretly sends a crew to capture corsair Chen Shao, who's accused of assassinating courtier Lin Renqi.

episodes.title: Episode 27
episodes.synopsis: Qiu Mingying pressures Zhiwei to resign from the court. Ning Yi helps Ning Qi realize that he's become Ning Sheng's scapegoat in the Chen Shao case.

episodes.title: Episode 28
episodes.synopsis: Zhiwei encounters Helian Zheng on her way back to the Qiu household. Chen Shao tells Ning Yi how he became a mercenary of the corrupt Lord of Minhai.

episodes.title: Episode 29
episodes.synopsis: Posing as Ning Yi, Ning Sheng uses Noble Consort Chang's hairpiece to deceive Zhan Bi, whom Ning Yi confronts about the death of his mother, Ya Le.

episodes.title: Episode 30
episodes.synopsis: Zhan Bi falls for Ning Sheng's plot to dishonor Ning Yi in front of the emperor, but the scheme backfires when Zhiwei intervenes.

episodes.title: Episode 31
episodes.synopsis: Helian Zheng tells Ning Yi he intends to ask for Zhiwei's hand in marriage -- right in front of Wei Zhi. Zhiwei urges Shao Ning to keep a low profile.

episodes.title: Episode 32
episodes.synopsis: As the Censorate chief, Ning Yi presents to the emperor evidence incriminating Lord of Minhai in Lin Renqi's case -- but Chen Shao ruins his plan.

episodes.title: Episode 33
episodes.synopsis: Zhiwei objects when Lord of Minhai asks the emperor for permission to train Ning Sheng. Headmaster Xin aims to put distance between Ning Yi and Zhiwei.

episodes.title: Episode 34
episodes.synopsis: Ning Yi brings up Lin Renqi's case when the emperor mentions Lord of Minhai's return to his dominion. Shao Ning suspects Ning Yi caused the blood marks.

episodes.title: Episode 35
episodes.synopsis: Shao Ning and Noble Consort Chang collude to keep Lady Wang silent about a past scheme against Ya Le. Wei Zhi is asked to guard the golden box.

episodes.title: Episode 36
episodes.synopsis: Helian Zheng discovers Wei Zhi's secret. Zhao Yuan reports to the emperor that Shao Ning has been orbiting around Noble Consort Chang and Ning Sheng.

episodes.title: Episode 37
episodes.synopsis: Ning Yi visits Ya Le's old home, Yilan Palace, and encounters a former servant. Noble Consort Chang arrives soon after -- and thinks she's seen a ghost.

episodes.title: Episode 38
episodes.synopsis: During an imperial gift ceremony, Lady Wang is agitated by false accusations -- and Ning Yi seizes the chance to reveal the truth about Ya Le's death.

episodes.title: Episode 39
episodes.synopsis: After Ning Sheng fails to access the golden box, Shao Ning and Peng Pei plant another distraction -- but someone else lurks in the shadows.

episodes.title: Episode 40
episodes.synopsis: Ning Yi gets wind of Ning Sheng's charade -- and a plan to take Wei Zhi's life. Shao Ning swaps the emperor's scroll, falling for Ning Yi's trap.

episodes.title: Episode 41
episodes.synopsis: Wei Zhi advises the emperor to send an envoy to Minhai. Shao Ning asks Ning Qi to help her obtain the emperor's approval to wed Wei Zhi.

episodes.title: Episode 42
episodes.synopsis: Headmaster Xin scrambles to keep Wei Zhi from blowing her cover. After rejecting Shao Ning's proposal, Wei Zhi makes a shocking revelation at court.

episodes.title: Episode 43
episodes.synopsis: As Zhiwei's execution looms, Qiu Mingying draws up a dangerous rescue plan with the Bloody Pagoda, but Ning Yi intervenes just in time.

episodes.title: Episode 44
episodes.synopsis: Ning Yi sends Qiu Mingying a message through Chief Gu. Against their father's orders, the Chang brothers set out to block Ning Yi's arrival in Minhai.

episodes.title: Episode 45
episodes.synopsis: Chang Zhongxin sets a trap for his brother, Zhongyi, and turns against his own father. Feng Hao steals an artifact from Qiu Mingying's closet.

episodes.title: Episode 46
episodes.synopsis: Zhongxin puts on an act to cover up his crime and prepares his troops for a rebellion. Zhiwei encounters Yan Huaishi's fiancée, Hua Qiong.

episodes.title: Episode 47
episodes.synopsis: Zhongxin takes advantage of Ning Yi's illness to put his plan in motion, but Yan Huaishi convinces Zhou Xizhong to help thwart Zhongxin's ambitions.

episodes.title: Episode 48
episodes.synopsis: After Feng Hao escapes from jail, Peng Pei seeks information on the Qiu family's link to the former dynasty -- and reports his suspicions to Ning Qi.

episodes.title: Episode 49
episodes.synopsis: After confronting Qiu Mingying about Feng Hao's identity, Headmaster Xin falls for Ning Qi and Peng Pei's trap, and Qiu Mingying is apprehended.

episodes.title: Episode 50
episodes.synopsis: Ning Qi orders his men to capture Master Zong. Qiu Mingying tells Headmaster Xin the only way to protect Zhiwei is to sacrifice herself and Feng Hao.

episodes.title: Episode 51
episodes.synopsis: Zhiwei forces her way into the emperor's court to defend her family. Ning Yi arrives soon after and implores the emperor to spare Zhiwei's life.

episodes.title: Episode 52
episodes.synopsis: Master Zong tells Zhiwei the truth about her birth origins. To protect Zhiwei, Ning Yi gives the emperor a life-or-death ultimatum.

episodes.title: Episode 53
episodes.synopsis: After granting permission for Helian Zheng to marry Zhiwei and return to Jinshi, the emperor orders Ning Yi to accompany them on the way.

episodes.title: Episode 54
episodes.synopsis: Ning Yi meets with the prince of Dayue with a proposal for an alliance. The emperor orders Gu Heng to keep a close eye on Ning Qi and Peng Pei.

episodes.title: Episode 55
episodes.synopsis: Helian Zheng confronts Helian Lie with an edict to dispute the succession, but Liu Mudan intervenes. Ning Yi investigates the Liu and Si families' past.

episodes.title: Episode 56
episodes.synopsis: Ning Yi frees a prisoner in order to help Zhiwei and Helian Zheng. Ning Qi orders fragrance-maker Yueling to replicate the emperor's incense box.

episodes.title: Episode 57
episodes.synopsis: Zhiwei grabs Liu Meiduo's sleeve and foils Helian Lie's plot against her and Ning Yi. Helian Zheng learns the truth about his father's death.

episodes.title: Episode 58
episodes.synopsis: Yueling steals a talisman from Ning Sheng's box before handing it to Ning Qi. Unrest in Jinshi interrupts Zhiwei and Helian Zheng's nuptials.

episodes.title: Episode 59
episodes.synopsis: Yueling overhears the emperor's conversation with Lingying, Ya Le's former servant. Ning Qi uses Shao Ning to frame Ning Yi.

episodes.title: Episode 60
episodes.synopsis: Ning Yi finds a way out of Zongzheng Temple and takes Lingying with him. To ferret out the real Zhiwei, Jin Siyu makes a deal with Zhiwei and Hua Qiong.

episodes.title: Episode 61
episodes.synopsis: Lingying tells Ning Yi a secret about his mother. Yueling hands the talisman to a man connected to the Dacheng Empire and schemes to expose Ning Qi.

episodes.title: Episode 62
episodes.synopsis: Jin Siyu identifies the real Zhiwei. To aid in Zhiwei's escape from Puyuan, Ning Yi asks Jiarong to deliver the map of a secret exit.

episodes.title: Episode 63
episodes.synopsis: Zhiwei wakes up with little recollection, and Jin Siyu leads her to think she's his consort. Ning Yi demolishes Puyuan with his rescue plan.

episodes.title: Episode 64
episodes.synopsis: The emperor refuses to grant Ya Le's wish to see Ning Yi and plans to make Ning Qi his successor. Yueling and Zhang Sunhong plot to undermine Ning Qi.

episodes.title: Episode 65
episodes.synopsis: Ning Qi delivers gift chests to Ya Le's residence -- but it's a Trojan horse. Ning Cheng arrives at the scene and clashes with Master Zong.

episodes.title: Episode 66
episodes.synopsis: After overhearing Zhang Sunhong and Ning Qi, Gu Nanyi takes matters into his own hands -- with fatal consequences. Two murders stir the palace.

episodes.title: Episode 67
episodes.synopsis: Zhiwei asks Zhang Sunhong to let go of the past. Headmaster Xin mentions Ning Qi's imminent revolt to Ning Ji, who doesn't intend to pursue the throne.

episodes.title: Episode 68
episodes.synopsis: Flanked by courtiers, Ning Qi rounds up troops outside the emperor's room, but Ning Yi and Zhao Yuan walk through the gate with a shocking announcement.

episodes.title: Episode 69
episodes.synopsis: Zhang Sunhong turns Zhiwei against Ning Yi, and Yueling leverages Ning Qi's grudge. Ning Cheng stops Zhiwei and Helian Zheng on their way to Jinshi.

episodes.title: Episode 70
episodes.synopsis: Gu Nanyi asks Yueling to tell Zhiwei the truth about Helian Zheng's fate. Zhiwei accepts Ning Yi's offer to make her empress, but she has other plans.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.synopsis: Wei Yingluo enters the Forbidden Palace as a maid to investigate her sister's death. The Emperor oversees the Hall Selection of new concubines and sends a reminder to the Harem on their conduct.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo’s attitude and abilities create tension in the Embroidery Workshop. Noble Consort Gao's involvement in Lady Yu's health leads to a confrontation, as the Empress continues to struggle with her management of the Harem. Yingluo encounters the Emperor for the first time.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo’s initial investigations into her sister's demise attract the attention of Momo Fang, and Yingluo is forced to improvise. Head Chamberlain Li Yu mounts a search for her after the tense encounter with the Emperor.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.synopsis: Guard Fucha Fuheng attempts to rouse his sister the Empress from her long-held grief. Noble Consort Gao and Consort Jia continue their scheming, leading to Yingluo being summoned.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo must think quickly when confronted by Noble Consort Gao. Momo Fang continues to seek retribution, and believes she has found an opportunity when rumours swirl around Yingluo’s conduct.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo considers how to gain access to the owner of a pendant who may be implicated in her sister’s death. The Emperor muses over his apparent rejection by one of his Consorts, while simultaneously spurning another close to him. The Embroidery Workshop is thrown into disarray when plans for the Empress’ birthday present go awry.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo’s quick thinking impresses the Empress, as the hunt continues for the one responsible for destroying the peacock thread. Yingluo and Linglong both aim to settle scores as they compete for a prestigious assignment.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo receives a mixed reception as she moves to the Empress’ palace, but is determined to make a good impression. Noble Consort Gao and Consort Jia discuss how to deal with the resilient maid. The Emperor mulls over how best to address a matter of political malfeasance by a family member of one of his consorts.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.synopsis: Consort Xian attempts to avoid palace intrigue, even as she grapples with a difficult family matter. Accusations are hurled after an incident at Consort Yu’s palace, which nevertheless allows Yingluo to get closer to Fucha Fuheng.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.synopsis: Mingyu’s resentment towards Yingluo grows as the latter endears herself to the Empress. Consort Xian struggles to secure funds in order to help a family member.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.synopsis: Noble Consort Gao continues to torment Consort Yu, although Yingluo remains vigilant to threats to her health. We are introduced further to Eunuch Yuan Chunwang, who suffers after being caught up in Consort Xian’s earlier efforts to assist a family member. Yingluo is entrusted with the care of the Emperor’s gift to the Empress.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.synopsis: The machinations of Noble Consort Gao and Consort Jia come to a head at the Empress’ birthday tea party. Consort Xian receives a solution to her money problems, but worries her integrity may have been compromised.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.synopsis: Consort Xian receives further troubling news about her family, leading the Empress to intercede in order to prevent further hurt. Yingluo makes a start on her reading and writing lessons.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo continues with her writing lessons, and is drawn to a night-time meeting by one of the Prince Ri’s guards. The Emperor makes a decision regarding Consort Jia, although Yingluo is critical of his approach. With an offering ceremony due to take place, Yingluo wonders whether the gathering of officials creates an opportunity for her.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo lays a trap during the sacrifice of the meat, If the emperor finds anyone has tempered with the meat then he will be furious and will punished anyone involved.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.synopsis: Concubine Xian comes to visit Jia in Lenggong. Jia becomes angry while pouring out her inner dissatisfaction and grievance, while ridiculing Concubine Xian's incompetence dealing with her family matters. In a brief moment Concubine Xian thought of everything she had experienced which push's her into a big reaction!

episodes.title: Episode 17
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo gets help from Fu Heng to secretly investigate and find the truth about her sister killer, While the Empresses is away, Yugui suddenly goes into labor and shocks everyone in the Changchun Palace. Consort Gao demands immediate action on a gravely important matter.

episodes.title: Episode 18
episodes.synopsis: Consort Gao argues that the Emperor should take swift action while Concubine Xian proposes to let the famous doctor Ye Tianshi from Jiangnan diagnose and treat the fifth eldest brother.

episodes.title: Episode 19
episodes.synopsis: The Emperor come down with a strange illness as the Empresses and Yingluo go to take care of him. Doctor Ye Tianshi enlists Yingluo's assists for an unorthodox treatment.

episodes.title: Episode 20
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo suspects someone has been secretly taking care of her during the night while she has been recovering. Mingu continue to disobey the Empress and takes her bad mood out on the Empresses other guests which causes unusually alliances that may have bad consequences. Everyone comes together to celebrate the Emperors birthday.

episodes.title: Episode 21
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo proposes a temporary truce with Mingyu to try and find the missing Buddhist Stone. Noble Lady Shu try's again to shame the Empress and get Yingluo removed from the Palace in an attempt to gain the favor of Consort Gao during the Emperor's Mother's visit.

episodes.title: Episode 22
episodes.synopsis: Consort Gao gets punished by the Emperors Mother. Noble Lady Shu apologies and comes up with a plan to try and enlist Yingluo's assistance in a lethal plot.

episodes.title: Episode 23
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo get accused of working with Consort Gao. The Emperor meets with his brothers while more information about what happened to Yinguo's sister's get's revealed.

episodes.title: Episode 24
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo sets a trap to try to catch the person who she believes attacked her sister.

episodes.title: Episode 25
episodes.synopsis: Someone try to silence Yinglou and protect the Emperors brother. The identity of Yunluo's sister's killer is finally reveal.

episodes.title: Episode 26
episodes.synopsis: Fucha Fuheng expresses his plan to the Empresses. While the Emperor suspects Yinglou might have an ulterior motive. The Emperor puts his suspension to the test.

episodes.title: Episode 27
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo continues to seek revenge for her sister, embolden she plans to pay a visit to Princess Yu.

episodes.title: Episode 28
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo begins her punishment at the workhouse. The Empresses expresses her feeling about Yingluo to the Emperor. Consort Xian pays her respects to the Fifth Brother following the passing of his mother.

episodes.title: Episode 29
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo rescues Yuan Chunwang from trouble and they agree to look out for each other. The Empress decides to delegate some of her duties to others so she can focus more on taking care of her health during the pregnancy.

episodes.title: Episode 30
episodes.synopsis: Consort Gao and Nalan Chunxue's plan to attack is Empress unleased during the Emperor's Mother's dinner. Consort Xian catches the eye of the Emperor's Mother by coming to her assistance in a time of need. Consort Gao also ceases the chance to get some revenge on Yingluo.

episodes.title: Episode 31
episodes.synopsis: Consort Xian makes a plan to give food to the refugees suffering by the floods, but a disturbance breaks out, can she handle this situation? In a time of need Yuan Chunwan sets up to help the Kingdom maintain the peace.

episodes.title: Episode 32
episodes.synopsis: Consort Gao prepare for the final practice performance before the Emperor's Mother's birthday, Some uninvited guests turn up for the final practice, will things go to plan for Consort Gao?

episodes.title: Episode 33
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo and Yuan Chunwan decide to become Brother and Sister. Mingyu and Fuhengs help Yingluo to secretly visit the Empress, but will her secret meetings be discovered? The Emperor is busy trying to deal with the floods and manage the kingdom.

episodes.title: Episode 34
episodes.synopsis: Someone try's to frame Yinglou for using a voodoo curse. Yuan Chunwan enlists the help of Fu-hung to try and rescue Yingluo. Fu-hung make a tough decision.

episodes.title: Episode 35
episodes.synopsis: ‎Consort Chun finally understands why Fuhang has never acknowledged her. Consort Xian deal's with the problem at the workshop and also gives some advice to Consort Chun. The Empress finally wakes up. Yuan Chunwang explains to Yingluo how he ended up in the Forbidden Kingdom.

episodes.title: Episode 36
episodes.synopsis: Erching and Fuhang get married. Yingluo is allowed to visit the Empress if she follows the Emperors grueling task.

episodes.title: Episode 37
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo goes back to try and help the Empress with her rehabilitation. Fu Heng's career is going well but he seems to be neglecting his marriage which leads to a troubling event with Erching.

episodes.title: Episode 38
episodes.synopsis: Fuheng has strong words for Erqing as he reveal's his true feelings. Erqing moves back to the palace with a plan to get close to the Empress.

episodes.title: Episode 39
episodes.synopsis: Erching seizes a chance to extract revenge in a plot against Fuheng. The Empress goes into labor as Mingyu and Yingluo assist the Empress as best they can. News travels around the Forbidden City but not everyone is happy about the new situation.

episodes.title: Episode 40
episodes.synopsis: ‎The Empress is heartbroken but the Emperor reminds her of her position and reasonability for the 6 palaces. Yingluo is still set to return to the place soon and will then discover all the recent events that have taken place in her absence.

episodes.title: Episode 41
episodes.synopsis: Consort Xian get's promoted to become the New Empress. Yingluo is sent out of the Forbidden city to take care of her her true Empresses grave. After 2 years a royal visit to honor her memory takes place.

episodes.title: Episode 42
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo makes a plan to get back to the Forbidden City with the ambition to help Mingyu out of trouble and perhaps find the truth behind what happened to her True Empresses son in that fire while she was away. With a possible promotion a good friend might be lost forever.

episodes.title: Episode 43
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo gets her own palace in the Forbidden City. Her new life as a noble lady begins.

episodes.title: Episode 44
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo soon gets bullied by other Noble Consorts with more status than her. Yingluo finds a way to deal with this current problem. Fuheng returns from his time in battle to see that not everything in the Forbidden City has stayed the same as before he left.

episodes.title: Episode 45
episodes.synopsis: Yinguo needs to endure rumors spread around the palace to discredit her. Yingluo make's the most of Consort Chun's handwork to gain some favor of her own.

episodes.title: Episode 46
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo uses one of Consort Chun's personal eunuch's against her to make a show for everyone to see during Consort Chun's well organized event. Yingluo and Fuheng meet while attending the remembrance. Noble Lady Jia set's a trap to catch Yingluo and Fuheng together.

episodes.title: Episode 47
episodes.synopsis: Consort Chun order's Yingluo to sew a masterpiece for the Emperor's Mother as a form of bulling and insists it needs to be finished in 1 month. While the Emperor is neglecting Yingluo, he comes to talk with Fuheng during a sparring session to get some answers.

episodes.title: Episode 48
episodes.synopsis: Now all the Noble Ladies feel Yinglou is very difficult to deal with as she always finds a new way to lure the Emperor to be her company instead of them. Consort Chun tries to explain why the stolen things ended up in the Xu Chu street organized by her. Just as Fuheng thinks things might improve with Erching's behavior he makes a discovery that shocks him.

episodes.title: Episode 49
episodes.synopsis: Fuheng finally has enough of Erching's wicked and cruel behavior. Yingluo helps the Emperor understand Fuheng and his desired career path better. The Emperor want's to teach Yingluo how to horse ride.

episodes.title: Episode 50
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo believes the horse ridding incident was no accident and asks the Emperor to investigate. The Empresses father's life hangs in the balance.

episodes.title: Episode 51
episodes.synopsis: The Empresses pleads to save her father life. An old lost friends returns. Yinglou teaches Mingu to dance but get interrupted as the Emperor pays a visit.

episodes.title: Episode 52
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo get pull into a plot of attempted murder, while Consort Chun demands imitate action. The Emperor and Empress ask for answers.

episodes.title: Episode 53
episodes.synopsis: The Kingdom is full of rumors and gossip over what happened to Consort Chun. Yingluo refuses to shy away from her hobbies even though there might be a connection to recent events.

episodes.title: Episode 54
episodes.synopsis: qing takes advantage of the Palace event and comes to seek an audience with the Emperor. Hupo comes to find Yingluo and try's to exchange information for a position in her Palace, this information pushes Yinglou and Mingyu to act in honor of their True Empress

episodes.title: Episode 55
episodes.synopsis: Someone is found possibly selling the palace's medicinal herbs, The Emperor orders an investigation. Bit by bit pieces are discovered but is there really something more sinister behind it all?

episodes.title: Episode 56
episodes.synopsis: Yuan Chunwang decides to pledge his loyalty to another. Yingluo and Yanxi palace are quiet and lonely now without the favor of the Emperor. Other Consort's see this as an opportunity to bully members of the Yanxi palace. The Empress continues to pull the strings behind other people in the Forbidden Palace.

episodes.title: Episode 57
episodes.synopsis: The Empress now with the Emperor's favor ‎continues her plot against the Emperor's mother. Yinglou never one to shy away from conflict try's to assist the Emperor's mother. A possible ally appears.

episodes.title: Episode 58
episodes.synopsis: Yinglou accompanies the Emperor's mother to yuan mingyuan park to recover.

episodes.title: Episode 59
episodes.synopsis: ‎The Emperors Mother encourages Yingluo to return to the Forbidden city, as a new Noble Lady has entered the palace and is now favored by the Emperor. The Empress asks Yingluo to join an alliance to defeat the Emperor's new favored Lady.

episodes.title: Episode 60
episodes.synopsis: Consort Shun gets questions by the Emperor's Mother. Hailancha will marry Minyu, but Minyu feels worried about the silver needle's still in her body.

episodes.title: Episode 61
episodes.synopsis: ‎Consort Shun gives Minyu a wedding gift. Yingluo prepares the wedding dress for Minyu. But Consort Shun words for Mingyu make her feel like she has no other option left.

episodes.title: Episode 62
episodes.synopsis: Yingluo finally realizes that it was Consort Shun's words that caused Minyu to suicide by making her think it was the only way to escape from her current situation. Consort Shun continues her plot to sir trouble but look innocent.

episodes.title: Episode 63
episodes.synopsis: Consort Shun plots to encourage Fuheng and the weak and starved Yingluo to escape the Forbidden City together. But her plan may in fact be a trap!

episodes.title: Episode 64
episodes.synopsis: ‎Finally the Emperor uncovers the truth behind the plot that involves Fuheng, Yingluo & Consort Shun.

episodes.title: Episode 65
episodes.synopsis: Year's have passed, ‎The Emperor favors Yingluo the most. The Empress feel's her position has left her tired and aged dealing with the many issues in the six palaces. Now that the Empress begins to lose focus Yuan Chunwang starts to plot in the background using the Empress power secretly.

episodes.title: Episode 66
episodes.synopsis: The Empress starts to worry about her looks and age more and more, which allows Yuan Chunwang to continue his plot from the shadows. He seeks to eliminate the competition of  the royal brothers one by one.

episodes.title: Episode 67
episodes.synopsis: The 4th brother try's to prove his innocence to the Emperor, Yuan Chunwang continues his plot and aims to focus on the Emperors brother and the Empress next.

episodes.title: Episode 68
episodes.synopsis: Another royal brother is targeted, but there is no evidence for Yingluo to prove anything. Yuan Chunwan suggests to Prince He that he should stage a munity against the Emperor. Prince He and Fuheng have a disagreement.

episodes.title: Episode 69
episodes.synopsis: All the pieces are in place for Prince He and the Empress to attempt their grab for power. Rebels attack the boat during the night, the plot has started!

episodes.title: Episode 70
episodes.synopsis: The Empress reveals her true feelings for the Emperor while Yuan Chunwang's plot and true identity are revealed. Yinglou has been poison from helping the 5th Royal brother. They await a cure from the battlefield but will it arrive in time.

episodes.title: Sneaking into the Gong Residence
episodes.synopsis: Assassin Yun Weishan sneaked into the Gong Residence with the purpose of becoming the wife of Gong Huanyu, the young lord of the Gong's, and obtaining information of the family. On the other side, Gong Ziyu realized that Wufeng assigned an assassin in the bride sent in. When Gong Hongyu found out, he decided to kill all the brides. Gong Ziyu couldn't bear it, and had a conflict with his father.

episodes.title: Gong Ziyu Rescued the Brides
episodes.synopsis: Gong Ziyu decided to rescue the brides by taking them to the secret tunnel. But they were soon caught by Gong Yuanzhi. Somehow, Zheng Nanyi was revealed to be a Wufeng assassin and was caught. Gong Ziyu thought he would be complimented by his father for catching the assassin. But it turned out that Gong Hongyu already knew Ziyu's plan.

episodes.title: The Identities
episodes.synopsis: The Council of Elders decided to start Absent Inheritance instantly, and Gong Ziyu was appointed the Sword Wielder. Ziyu was determined to find out the truth. The poisonings in Ladies' Hostel caught Ziyu's attention. Yun Weishan now understood that Shangguan Qian was also a spy, so she revealed her identity to Qian. Weishan changed her target the now Sword Wielder, Gong Ziyu. But first, she had to survive the crisis of being exposed.

episodes.title: The Bride of Gong Ziyu
episodes.synopsis: Gong Ziyu let his people search the Ladies' Hostel. But Shangguan Qian and Yun Weishan were well prepared. With the appointment of the new Sword Wielder, the bride had to be reselected. Yun Weishan became Ziyu's bride, as she wished. Gong Shangjue questioned the appointment, as he's suspicious of Gong Ziyu's lineage. Gong Ziyu also revealed his doubts about Gong Yuanzhi.

episodes.title: Qualification
episodes.synopsis: The result of the investigation was announced. Yun Weishan's identity was said to be inaccurate. However, Weishan persisted her identity. Gong Ziyu took this chance to testify against Gong Yuanzhi in front of the Elders.

episodes.title: The Qingfeng Sect
episodes.synopsis: Shangguan Qian told Gong Shangjue about their crossed past. Though Shangjue was slightly touched, he still hadn't let go of his doubt. Yun Weishan gently took care of Gong Ziyu. The two grew closer to each other. Ziyu asked Jin Fan about the Trial, but Jin Fan kept his mouth shut.

episodes.title: Being Suspected
episodes.synopsis: Jin Fan suspected Yun Weishan was related to Wufeng. Weishan explained that she was taught by Qingfeng's Zhuo Mei long ago as a return of favor, as well as a request of revenge. Gong Zishang and Jin Fan were unable to verify, but they understood that Weishan truly wanted to help Ziyu. So they let her enter the back hill. Gong Ziyu met Elder Yue as he entered the cave. Elder Yue was worried, so he decided to send Ziyu off. But Ziyu must cover his eyes.

episodes.title: Ziyu's Confession
episodes.synopsis: As Yun Weishan was about to be attacked. Gong Ziyu rushed over to claim that Weishan was his Green Jade Guardian. Weishan also took out the bracelet which Jin Fan gave her, to prove her identiy. Gong Ziyu hoped to become closer with Yun Weishan. Therefore he proposed calling Weishan as Yun. He also promised that he would not let Yun to suffer anymore, and that he'd always protect her.

episodes.title: Cold Hands, Warm Heart
episodes.synopsis: Gong Ziyu was sick after getting into the Ice Pool. Yun Weishan rushed to the clinic to get medicine for Ziyu.

episodes.title: First Kiss
episodes.synopsis: Gong Ziyu takes the medicine made by Yun Weishan, which helps increase his power. He successfully sneaks into the ice pool and obtains the book. When he returns to the surface, he is exhausted so Yun Weishan gives him artificial respiration. He completes the first trial.

episodes.title: Betrayal
episodes.synopsis: Gong Ziyu returns after finishing learning the techniques. When he wants to tell the good news to his family, he finds that Mrs. Wuji is reluctant to see him, and Yu Weishan gets stuck. Gong Ziyu cannot face the betrayal of Yun Weishan.

episodes.title: Fortnight Flies
episodes.synopsis: Yun Weishan comes to accompany Gong Ziyu, who has a heart to heart talk with her. He thinks the joke makes her shy but he doesn’t know she is being influenced by the Fortnight Flies.

episodes.title: Sweet Time
episodes.synopsis: Gong Ziyu and Yun Weishan go to the market together with Gong Zishang and Jin Fan. The latter two intentionally create the opportunity for the two of them to get along with each other. Gong Yuanzhi wants to give Gong Shangjue a lantern but sadly leaves when he sees him having dinner with Shangguan Qian.

episodes.title: The Second Trial
episodes.synopsis: Gong Ziyu starts his second trial with Yun Weishan. Elder Yue meets them and they take the boat to the trial site. Although it seems to be calm and peaceful, it is extremely dangerous.

episodes.title: The Mountain
episodes.synopsis: Gong Yuanzhi tells Shangguan Qian that Gong Shangjue has left the Gong residence and asks her to take a good rest. Shangguan Qian questions where Gong Shangjue had gone. Gong Yuanzhi accidentally tells her he went to the back mountains, and she becomes very curious about this place.

episodes.title: Jealousy
episodes.synopsis: Gong Shangjue asks the servants to prepare new clothes for Shangguan Qian. When Gong Yuanzheng notices his brother cares so much about Shangguan Qian, he is so dissatisfied with it.

episodes.title: Medicine for Controlling Mind
episodes.synopsis: Jin Fan curiously asks Gong Ziyu if there are any medicines for controlling people’s minds in the world. Gong Ziyu gives him some medicine and asks him to try. Jin Fan thinks that he is cheating him.

episodes.title: Saving Weishan Once Again
episodes.synopsis: Yuanzhi brings people over to Xue Lineage to capture Weishan. Ziyu appears at the right time, claiming that he sent Weishan over to get snow lotus, in order to save her. Zishang meets up with Xiao Hei, wanting him to accompany him to steal something.

episodes.title: Break Away
episodes.synopsis: Gong Ziyu decides to rescue Yun Weishan. With the help of Xue Chongzi and others, he successfully takes Weishan out. But Gong Yuanzheng and Gong Shangjue are both injured. Ziyu understands that he might be punished by the Elders for breaking the prison; therefore, he starts his third realm's trial right away.

episodes.title: Confession
episodes.synopsis: After Wuji's death, Yun Weishan comforted the painful Gong Ziyu, and the two expressed their thoughts to each other...

episodes.title: The Infinite Heat
episodes.synopsis: Gong Ziyu becomes the sword wielder. The elders tell him about the Infinite Heat and the secret of the back hill. At this moment, an explosion occurred in Shang Lineage. Gong Zishang suffered a serious injury.

episodes.title: Trap
episodes.synopsis: At the ceremony, everyone fights fiercely with Wufeng, but Wufeng does not expect this is the trap arranged by Gong Ziyu, Yun Weishan and Gong Shangjue.

episodes.title: The Stealer
episodes.synopsis: Jin Fan is brought back along with the Chuyun Chonglian. Gong Ziyu wants to give it to Jin Fan but is rejected by Zishang. Ziyu expresses that Jin Fan is like family to him and that Jin Fan is just as important as him.

episodes.title: I Am Always Waiting for You
episodes.synopsis: Gong Huanyu is reluctant to be caught. Finally, Gong Ziyu and Yun Weishan cooperate with each other to defeat Gong Huanyu. Yun Weishan knows her real identity and hopes to return to her hometown. Gong Ziyu is still waiting for his lover.
